recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If MolecularDefinition coordinateInterval semantics are considered ambiguous, handle that as a new MolecularDefinition-specific Clinical Genomics/incubator issue rather than resurrecting retired Sequence wording in core.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive Clinical Genomics change request for FHIR-core-Sequence asking to clarify Sequence.coordinateSystem so 0-based coordinates use an inclusive start and exclusive end, while 1-based coordinates use an inclusive start and inclusive end.
initial_application: Commit d830ddede2fa70d5f6ccca85e723caa4a2c7a7bf applied the request by updating the Sequence spreadsheet source, and historical release3/release4 artifacts preserve the requested Sequence/MolecularSequence coordinateSystem wording.
additional_context: Current source/fhir.ini lists Sequence under removed resources, MolecularSequence is commented/deleted, and later R6 decisions including FHIR-51227 and FHIR-50365 replaced legacy MolecularSequence with MolecularDefinition/additional-resource material. Current MolecularDefinition uses a different coordinateInterval/CodeableConcept model, so porting the old integer coordinateSystem text would require a new model-specific decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No authoritative current FHIR-core source file was changed.
